newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinian youth dies of wounds in Hebron clash.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian youth dies of wounds in Hebron clash.

text.p: A 14-year-old Palestinian shot by Israeli soldiers in clashes in Hebron last month died of his wounds on Thursday, the boy's family and hospital officials said.
Youssef Ibrahim al-Jabari was shot in the head by a rubber-coated metal slug. Officials at East Jerusalem's Maqassed hospital pronounced Jabari dead on Thursday.

Jabari was the fifth person from Hebron to die in four months of sporadic clashes between stone-throwing youths and Israeli troops since Israel broke ground on a Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem in March, Palestinians said.
Later on Thursday hundreds of masked activists of the PLO's main Fatah group, some clutching knives and axes, marched in Hebron pledging to fight against Israel if necessary.
"This is a military march to show the Israeli side there are many youths ready to fight if Israel crosses the red line over the national rights of the Palestinian nation," said one protester.
Hebron was rocked by particularly fierce clashes last month after a Jewish woman pasted anti-Moslem posters depicting the prophet Mohammad as a pig on storefronts in the conservative town.
The woman has been charged with committing a racist act, harming religious sensitivities, supporting a terrorist group and endangering life by stoning an Arab car.

Israel handed 80 percent of Hebron to Palestinian rule in January but kept troops in the heart of the town to protect some 400 Jewish settlers who live in fortified enclaves amid 100,000 Palestinian residents.
